Name: 15 x 15 Greenhouse
Author: bambolambo
Description:
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/15-x-15-greenhouse.109785/]Stardew Valley Forums[/url]
Bigger greenhouse for people who want it.
15 x 15

Installation:

NOTE: Remove any chest or any items you have inside of the greenhouse and make sure no crops are planted before installing and uninstalling
this mod.

Make sure to back up your Greenhouse.xnb located at ...\Content\Maps\Greenhouse.xnb

Overwrite Greenhouse.xnb located at \Content\Maps\Greenhouse.xnb with the one that you downloaded.
